newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 475.25/475.70/dlr - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 475.25/475.70/dlr - Sept 24.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 475.25/475.70 against the dollar in a slow day's trade, brokers said.
"Some corporate clients bought dollars in the morning, but the afternoon was almost still," said one trader.
Traders said dollar inflows from foreign investors in the stock market continued to support the bolivar leaving "little need for the Central Bank to supply the market."
